# SurveyMonkey
> SurveyMonkey is an online survey and forms platform for collecting feedback, conducting research, and automating insights.

SurveyMonkey provides tools for surveys, forms, market research, customer experience, and employee feedback, along with templates, integrations, and developer resources for building data collection workflows.

## Product Overview
- [SurveyMonkey Home](https://www.surveymonkey.com/): Main entry point for SurveyMonkey’s survey, form, and feedback platform.
- [Online Surveys](https://www.surveymonkey.com/product/surveys/): Overview of survey creation, distribution, and analysis capabilities.
- [Online Forms](https://www.surveymonkey.com/product/forms/): Product page for building forms for registrations, requests, and data collection.
- [Market Research Solutions](https://www.surveymonkey.com/product/market-research/): Overview of tools for concept testing, audience targeting, and research studies.
- [Customer Experience](https://www.surveymonkey.com/product/customer-experience/): Product information for measuring and improving customer satisfaction and loyalty.
- [Employee Experience](https://www.surveymonkey.com/product/employee-experience/): Overview of employee feedback and engagement measurement solutions.
- [Enterprise](https://www.surveymonkey.com/product/enterprise/): Enterprise-grade administration, security, and collaboration features.
- [Integrations](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/): Directory of integrations connecting SurveyMonkey with business tools.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://help.surveymonkey.com/): Central support hub for account, billing, survey, and feature documentation.
- [Create a Survey](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/create/): Guidance for building surveys, adding questions, and configuring design.
- [Send Your Survey](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/send/): Documentation for collectors, distribution methods, and response collection.
- [Analyze Results](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/analyze/): Help articles on reports, filters, exports, and response analysis.
- [Account and Login](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/account/): Support for account settings, login issues, and profile management.
- [Billing and Plans](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/billing/): Articles covering subscriptions, invoices, renewals, and payment management.
- [Forms Help](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/forms/): Documentation for creating and managing online forms.
- [Integrations Help](https://help.surveymonkey.com/en/surveymonkey/integrations/): Support content for connecting SurveyMonkey with third-party applications.

## Developer Platform
- [Developer Portal](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/): Entry point for SurveyMonkey API documentation and developer resources.
- [API Overview](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/api/v3/): Overview of the SurveyMonkey API and core concepts.
- [API Reference](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/api/v3/#api-endpoints): Endpoint-level reference for surveys, collectors, responses, and users.
- [OAuth 2.0 Guide](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/api/v3/#oauth-2-0): Authentication documentation for authorizing applications with SurveyMonkey accounts.
- [Webhooks](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/api/v3/#webhooks): Reference for subscribing to SurveyMonkey events and notifications.
- [Developer Apps](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/apps/): Manage developer applications and API credentials.
- [Developer Support](https://developer.surveymonkey.com/support/): Support resources for API usage, app setup, and integration questions.

## Templates and Examples
- [Survey Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/): Library of prebuilt survey templates for common use cases.
- [Customer Satisfaction Survey Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/customer-satisfaction-surveys/): Ready-made templates for measuring customer feedback and satisfaction.
- [Employee Engagement Survey Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/employee-engagement-surveys/): Templates for assessing employee morale, engagement, and workplace sentiment.
- [Event Feedback Survey Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/event-feedback-surveys/): Templates for collecting attendee feedback after events and sessions.
- [Market Research Survey Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/market-research-surveys/): Templates for product research, brand studies, and audience insights.
- [Registration Form Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/registration-forms/): Form templates for signups, registrations, and information capture.
- [Feedback Form Templates](https://www.surveymonkey.com/templates/feedback-forms/): Form templates for collecting structured feedback across scenarios.

## Solutions by Use Case
- [Customer Feedback](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/customer-feedback-surveys/): Resources for collecting and acting on customer opinions and satisfaction data.
- [Employee Feedback](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/employee-feedback-surveys/): Guidance and templates for gathering employee input and workplace feedback.
- [Market Research](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/market-research-surveys/): Use-case resources for running market research and audience studies.
- [Event Registration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/event-registration-form-template/): Template-driven workflow for event signup and registration collection.
- [Net Promoter Score](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/net-promoter-score-nps-survey-template/): NPS survey template and resources for loyalty measurement.
- [Customer Satisfaction Score](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/customer-satisfaction-survey-template/): CSAT survey template for measuring customer satisfaction.
- [Employee Satisfaction](https://www.surveymonkey.com/mp/employee-satisfaction-survey-template/): Survey template for evaluating employee satisfaction and workplace experience.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Directory](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/): Browse available integrations for automation, CRM, collaboration, and analytics tools.
- [Salesforce Integration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/salesforce/): Connect SurveyMonkey with Salesforce for feedback and CRM workflows.
- [Microsoft Teams Integration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/microsoft-teams/): Share surveys and collaborate on feedback inside Microsoft Teams.
- [Slack Integration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/slack/): Send notifications and share survey activity through Slack.
- [Google Sheets Integration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/google-sheets/): Export or sync survey data with Google Sheets workflows.
- [Mailchimp Integration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/mailchimp/): Connect survey responses with email marketing and audience segmentation.
- [HubSpot Integration](https://www.surveymonkey.com/integrations/hubspot/): Use SurveyMonkey data in HubSpot marketing and CRM processes.
